blocks.text: Condo buildings in Bear Creek Green Timbers
Kings Landing — 13628 81A Avenue

An Apartment/Condo building by Dawson + Sawyer south of Bear Creek Park: current listings record sub-type Apartment/Condo, built 2020, with clubhouse and bike room among the amenities, and a building-directory header describes the address as a wood-frame development with pets allowed. The directory header's "251 Unit Development" figure is a development-wide header figure, not a count for this building alone.
Kings Landing II (condominiums) — 13623 81A Avenue

The second Kings Landing condo building, by Dawson + Sawyer: the developer-project record describes a 6-storey woodframe mid-rise of 112 condominiums at King George Boulevard & 81A Avenue, with an expected completion of September 2021; current listings record the building as built 2021, sub-type Apartment/Condo, with clubhouse, exercise centre, in-suite laundry and storage, and one listing records pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed.
Streets, schools and getting around Bear Creek Green Timbers

items.t: Bear Creek Green Timbers is one board sub-area with a compound name — one of 15 sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "Surrey" in the SnapStats data — not two separate areas for "Bear Creek" and "Green Timbers." The City of Surrey lists seven communities (City Centre, Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton, South Surrey, Whalley) and "Bear Creek Green Timbers" is not one of them; the City places Bear Creek Park in Whalley, beside the Surrey Arts Centre, while Green Timbers is the urban-forest ground in the city's north-centre.
Surrey community medians: detached $1,215,000; attached $512,944, $491/sq ft, 99% sale-to-list, 25 days on market.
The rest of the named attached stock verified in is townhouse form.

Transit: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain project's Green Timbers Station will be located at 140 Street and Fraser Highway, on the westernmost edge of Green Timbers Urban Forest, facilitating access to the Jim Pattison Outpatient Care and Surgery Centre, the BC RCMP E-Divisional Headquarters and Surrey Memorial Hospital; TransLink states the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City has an anticipated in-service date of 2029. No SkyTrain station operates in this sub-area today.

blocks.text: Good to know about Bear Creek Green Timbers

items.t: The whole known apartment supply is one developer's one project. Both apartment buildings in this sub-area are Dawson + Sawyer's Kings Landing phases on the same avenue — a buyer comparing "different buildings" here is mostly comparing phases, ages (2020 vs 2021) and strata plans inside a single master-planned community.

Bear Creek Park sits in the City's Whalley framing (with the Surrey Arts Centre nearby) while Green Timbers Urban Forest anchors the north-centre — a search run under only "Bear Creek Green Timbers" misses City documents filed under either park name alone.

The coming station is at the forest's edge, not in the middle of the sub-area. Green Timbers Station will stand at 140 Street and Fraser Highway on the westernmost edge of Green Timbers Urban Forest — station proximity varies sharply across this large sub-area, and the project itself names Surrey Memorial Hospital and the RCMP E-Division headquarters among the facilities it will serve.

The townhouse stock is materially older than the condo stock. Carlingwood was built around 2000, two decades before the Kings Landing apartment buildings — depreciation-report and envelope questions that barely arise in the 2020/2021 buildings are central in the townhouse complex.

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: three pockets — the 81A Avenue / 136A Street cluster south of Bear Creek Park (the Kings Landing townhomes), the 84 Avenue cluster facing Bear Creek Park (the Trails townhouse component), and the Fleetwood-edge pocket at 151 Street (Carlingwood).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Bear Creek Green Timbers

items.t: Form B diligence (all 3 strata complexes above): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For Carlingwood (c. 2000) and the Trails townhouses (1994–1995) the depreciation report is the central document; the Kings Landing townhouses (2016–2020) are young stock by comparison.

Secondary suites and coach houses (Surrey): one secondary suite may be permitted per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, capped at 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable floor area, and never inside a coach house or garden suite; a coach house or garden suite must be at least 35 m² and at most 75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 where the existing house or duplex is below maximum FAR, smaller R3–R6 lots require lane access for a coach house, and one extra parking space is required.

blocks.text: Good to know about Bear Creek Green Timbers

items.t: One name, two forms, two addresses on the same block. A name-based search mixes all three — the address and the MLS sub-type are the only safe keys.

The townhouse stock is materially older than the condo stock — except for one project. Carlingwood dates to c. 2000 and the Trails townhouses to 1994–1995, roughly two decades before the Kings Landing apartment buildings (2020/2021); the Kings Landing townhomes (2016–2020) are the only counted townhouse stock of that newer era.
This sub-area is a hole in Surrey's 55+ map.

blocks.text: Bear Creek Green Timbers home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers with a median price of $748,250 (the middle half sold between $731,250 and $798,125), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $501 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $358 a month. 10 condos sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers with a median price of $521,500 (the middle half sold between $452,750 and $546,375), taking a median of 47 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $658 per square foot, a median year built of 2020 and a median strata fee of $420 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 34 condos and townhomes listed in Bear Creek Green Timbers. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Bear Creek Green Timbers?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Bear Creek Green Timbers had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Bear Creek Green Timbers a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 19 condos and townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers over those 5 months, out of 737 in all of Surrey.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: One board sub-area with a compound name. The City does not use the name at all — it places Bear Creek Park in Whalley and treats Green Timbers as the urban-forest ground in the north-centre — so City documents for this area are filed under Whalley, Newton, Fleetwood and Guildford framings, not under the board name.
faq.q: Is Bear Creek Green Timbers one area or two?

faq.a: In one cluster: Kings Landing (13628 81A Avenue, built 2020) and Kings Landing II condominiums (13623 81A Avenue, 112 condominiums in a 6-storey woodframe mid-rise, built 2021), both by Dawson + Sawyer on 81A Avenue south of Bear Creek Park. The sub-area's other named attached stock — Carlingwood and the Kings Landing townhomes — is townhouse form.
faq.q: Where are the actual apartment condos here?

faq.a: It can be either. The Dawson + Sawyer community includes two apartment buildings (13628 and 13623 81A Avenue) and 244 townhomes in 22 lowrise buildings at neighbouring addresses. Read the MLS sub-type on the specific unit.
faq.q: A listing says "Kings Landing" — is it a condo or a townhouse?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, and a Kings Landing II listing itself records rentals allowed. Short-term rentals can still be restricted; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Kings Landing condo long-term?

faq.a: Green Timbers Station (140 Street and Fraser Highway) is a named station on the Surrey Langley SkyTrain project, and TransLink states an anticipated in-service date of 2029 for the 16-kilometre extension — a plan fact today, not a service.
faq.q: When does SkyTrain reach Green Timbers?

faq.a: Three, all strata: the Kings Landing II townhomes, Carlingwood, and the Trails at Bear Creek Park townhouse component.
faq.q: How many townhouse complexes are in Bear Creek Green Timbers?

faq.a: It can be either. The Dawson + Sawyer community includes two apartment buildings (13628 and 13623 81A Avenue) and 244 townhomes in 22 lowrise buildings at neighbouring addresses (8168 136A Street, 13636 81A Avenue). Read the MLS sub-type on the specific unit.
faq.q: A listing says "Kings Landing" — is it a condo or a townhouse?

faq.a: The townhouse component is at 13660 84 Avenue (freehold strata, garden-level townhomes); the apartment component is at 13680 84 Avenue (Apartment/Condo listings). Built form governs: confirm the address and sub-type, not just the name, before comparing fees or restrictions.

What did townhomes in Bear Creek Green Timbers sell for?
faq.a: 18 townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $748,250.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Bear Creek Green Timbers?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
